instructions: Original worktrees were not modified. Snapshot contains only three reused Shadow services and their tests, no GPS polling source.
Pass --shadow-root pointing to a compatible separate Git worktree with these exact files. The lab also reads Git HEAD metadata; the raw four-file snapshot alone is not a runnable shadow-root.
For another machine, obtain approved ML repo and Shadow source reference separately; validate hashes. Never replace active GPS with an older source tree.
Shadow services are only compiled by explicit Lab.targets. No runtime registration, synthetic model acceptance or public ML activation.
